proposals.hypothesis: All user journeys (browse, cart, checkout) will degrade due to high error rates and increased latency. The frontend will show a 'Product catalog unavailable' message, but the checkout process will fail because product lookup is required.
proposals.reason: Highest impact: critical service used in all 3 user journeys with high fan-in (3 callers). Prior service-down run showed 96.55% error rate, so pod-kill tests if the failure is more severe or if the system recovers faster. This reveals real user impact for product catalog availability.

proposals.hypothesis: All user journeys will degrade with high error rates for cart operations. The cart may become empty (data loss) due to failed communication with redis-cart, causing checkout failures.
proposals.reason: Critical service with high journey coverage (3) and fan-in (2). We haven't tested pod-kill here. This reveals real user impact for cart functionality, especially since redis-cart (tested) causes data loss, so this experiment tests if cartservice failure compounds the issue.

proposals.hypothesis: All user journeys will degrade with high error rates for currency conversion. The frontend will show 'Currency conversion unavailable', but checkout will fail due to missing currency data.
proposals.reason: Critical service used in all 3 user journeys with fan-in (2). This tests if currency conversion failure breaks the user experience, which is essential for pricing and checkout. No pod-kill tests exist for this service.
